steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: Hehe, I'm over here. Come and get me!

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: Come on, you can do this. You're way better than the servants in my home.
You've been running around for almost twenty minutes. Every inch of your body is screaming in pain. You feel sore all over.
The shadow figure doesn't even bother to hide. It just stands on the roadside, waiting for you to get closer.
It vanishes right before you touch it. That's your fourteenth failed attempt.

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: Oh, that was quite close. Better luck next time.
It vanishes whenever you're about to touch it, just like what happened yesterday.

options: Get it into a confined space

steps.content: It's nimble on its feet. If you can get it into a confined space, you stand a better chance of catching it.
You plan out a route in your head and chase it to a narrow street lined with shops. It seems a little surprised but doesn't suspect anything.
For some reason, it's moving somewhat slower in this shopping street.
Now you see it again. It's flattened itself against the display window of a toy shop, with the lantern tied behind it.

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: Wow! An action figure of Chiyo.

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: What a creative design. Gotta get Daddy to buy it for me.

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: Ahhh! There's more of them. How I wish I could take them all home!
The shadow figure is distracted by the toys behind the display window. You reach out to touch it.

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: Huh! A sneak attack?

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: That's so much fun! Much more fun than playing with the servants. They're all worried about hurting me by accident. Let's continue! Come and get me!
It runs, and you give chase. Eventually, you drive it into a dead-end alley.
You proclaim triumphantly, as you approach the cornered shadow figure.

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: Not so fast. Hehe, you haven't really caught me yet.
It waves at you. You lunge forward, with your hand reached out.
Before you can touch it, it merges into and passes through the wall.
Thump!
The only thing you catch is the sound of you hitting the concrete wall.

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: Haha, better luck next time~
You hear its voice coming from the other side of the wall.
